title: Pair a host
signInFirst: Sign in to h4rn-connect before pairing

empty.title: Scan a pairing code
empty.body: Open the code on the host from Settings → Devices, then scan it with this device. The link brings you back here to confirm.
empty.typeCode: Or type the code under the QR

credentials: Credentials stay on {{host}}. You can revoke this phone from any other device.
credentialsUnnamed: Credentials stay on the host. You can revoke this phone from any other device.

foot.codesOnce_one: Codes work once and expire in {{count, number}} minute
foot.codesOnce_other: Codes work once and expire in {{count, number}} minutes

sas.waitingLabel: Waiting for {{name}} to approve this phone
sas.mustApprove: {{name}} must approve this phone before it can connect.
sas.scanned: Scanned code. Compare it before you trust the host.
sas.typed: Paired through a typed code. Compare it before you trust the host.
sas.waitingNote: On {{name}}, open Settings → Devices and confirm the same code. This screen updates when {{name}} approves this phone.
sas.compareNote: {{name}} shows this code under Settings → Devices. If it reads the same, no third party can read this connection. If it is different, someone between you and the host has replaced the key.
sas.approvalRequired: Host approval is required: after you confirm here, approve the same code on {{name}}.

errors.notPairingLink: That QR code is not an h4rn pairing link.
errors.expired: That pairing code has expired. Generate a new one on the host.
errors.signInToScan: Sign in to h4rn-connect first, then scan the pairing code again.
errors.signInToType: Sign in to h4rn-connect first, then enter the code again.
errors.otherConnect: This code belongs to {{url}}. Sign out and sign in there first.
errors.notApproved: {{name}} has not approved this device yet. Open Settings → Devices on {{name}}, confirm the same code, then try again.
errors.codesDiffer: The codes did not match, so this device was revoked. Pair again from a network you trust.
errors.missingDaemonOrToken: This pairing link has no daemon address or token. Copy the whole link from the host again.

hostsPane.emptyBody: A host is a machine running the h4rn daemon. Pair this device or add a host on your tailnet to give agents somewhere to run.
hostsPane.note: Presence is a dot plus a word. A WSL distribution is its own host, so pairing the Windows host does not grant the distribution.

phoneShell.title: Connect this phone
phoneShell.intro: Point h4rn at the daemon you already run. The token is the one `{{command}}` prints; it is stored in the Android Keystore, not in plain text.
phoneShell.hint: Emulator build: run `{{script}}`, which starts the daemon, wires `{{reverse}}` and passes this URL and token. Or paste the pairing link / direct QR shown on the host.
phoneShell.typeInstead: You can still type the URL and token.
phoneShell.badScheme: The daemon URL must be ws:// or wss:// (http/https also work).
